maya: Quick accessibility pass on the new 'Run' toolbar — ran VoiceOver and NVDA. A couple of small but important nits: focus on the status pill is almost invisible and VoiceOver only reads 'button' with no state. Screenshot: https://redwood.dev/snip/toolbar-ss.png sam: Thanks — can you paste what VoiceOver reads and what you expected? maya: On mac+VoiceOver: it just says 'Button'. Expected: something like 'Run status, Running, 42 percent'. Also contrast for the green "Done" pill is low on white — fails 4.5:1 per axe. teresa: Agreed. Two fixes: 1) make status region a proper live region so SRs announce updates, 2) give the pill an explicit aria-label reflecting the state. Suggest `role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` on the container to avoid choppy reads. sam: Sounds straightforward. Proposed markup for the status area: ```html
``` This keeps the pill focusable and readable. maya: Also noticed keyboard behavior is inconsistent: Enter opens the details menu, Space triggers the retry action in some states. We should standardize: Enter = open/activate primary control, Space = toggle/secondary when appropriate. I'll update the interaction doc. lucas: I'll update the handlers. For focus ring styling I propose a visible ring that meets contrast and is unobtrusive for mouse users. Example CSS: ```css .status-pill:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(2,132,199,0.28); /* good visibility */ border-radius: 6px; } @media (hover: hover) { .status-pill:focus:not(:focus-visible) { box-shadow: none; } } ``` Can Teresa sanity-check the color in high-contrast? teresa: That color is fine but bump alpha to 0.6 for older LCD readability. Also, to avoid reading floods when status updates frequently, debounce live-region announcements (e.g., 800ms) and only announce the final value. Keep `aria-atomic="true"` so partial DOM updates don't trigger extra reads. sam: Good call. I'll implement debounce in the status sync layer. Also will ensure we don't duplicate announcements when the pill itself has an aria-label and the container is a live region. We should only update the live region text content, not re-render the button element every tick. maya: Tiny copy suggestion: change 'Completed' => 'Done' and 'Failed' => 'Failed — try again' for clearer SR phrasing. Shorter reads help with screen reader scanning. lucas: :thumbsup: I prefer 'Done' too. Will include in PR along with color fixes and keyboard handler cleanup. axebot: axe scan: current 'Failed' pill text contrast = 3.8:1. Needs color tweak to meet 4.5:1. Also flagged missing live region on status updates. sam: Noted. I'll open a PR titled "status-pill: a11y fixes (aria, focus, keyboard, contrast)" and link this thread. Planning to include unit tests for the status aria text and a small e2e with VoiceOver emulation. maya: Awesome — thank you. If anyone can test on NVDA/JAWS after the PR that'd be great. I'll add test cases to the design checklist. teresa: Thanks — once PR lands I'll run a focused SR sweep. Small wins here will really help keyboard/SR users.
